subject.title: Control UI chat history hardcoded to 100 messages, no load more pagination

question: Should Control UI resolve this issue by accepting a larger fixed startup history window, or should closure require load-older pagination over chat.history offsets?
rationale: Source inspection proves the cap and the offset-capable backend, but the docs intentionally describe bounded recent history for stability, so automation cannot choose the UX/performance contract.

options.title: Require load-older pagination
options.body: Keep the initial history load bounded and resolve this through the canonical scrollback/pagination path or a narrowed replacement.

options.title: Accept a larger fixed window
options.body: Allow the linked 500-message mitigation to close this issue after real Control UI proof shows acceptable browser responsiveness.

recommendation.title: Require load-older pagination
recommendation.body: Keep the initial history load bounded and resolve this through the canonical scrollback/pagination path or a narrowed replacement.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest product-direction and adjacent WebChat/Gateway history signal among the likely owners.
